transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I... I’ve been thinking a lot lately about whether my family would be better off if I just weren’t here anymore. It just feels like everything has gotten to be too much, and I'm only dragging them down.
Have you felt this way or experienced these symptoms of low mood and hopelessness in the past, or is this the first time you have ever felt this way?

No, I've never felt like this before—this is the first time I've ever experienced this kind of terrible cycle. This heavy, hopeless feeling has been hanging over me for about the past nine months, starting right after my husband's health declined and I crashed from all that high energy I had. I just feel completely stuck in this low and I can't seem to get out of it.

You mentioned having a period of high energy before this low point; during that time, did you feel unusually talkative, need very little sleep, or find yourself taking on many risky or impulsive projects?

Oh, absolutely—I was talking so fast that people couldn't get a word in, and I felt like I had an endless battery, running around from dawn till past midnight. I took on way too many projects at once, like leading multiple church committees and starting business classes, which ended up causing a lot of conflict over my spending and commitments. Looking back, I feel so embarrassed about how chaotic and disruptive I was being to everyone around me.
During that high-energy period, did you experience any unusual perceptions, such as hearing voices or believing things that others told you were not true?

No, I never heard any voices or saw things that weren't there. But I did have some very strong beliefs that others didn't agree with, like honestly believing I was specially chosen to turn my little quilting shop into a national brand and fix all the historical society's problems. I just brushed off anyone who told me to slow down because I thought I understood things so much better than they did.

During these past nine months of feeling low, have you experienced any physical symptoms like a complete loss of appetite, significant weight loss, or an inability to feel any pleasure in activities you usually enjoy?

I have completely lost interest in my quilting and gardening; the fabric just sits there and the weeds take over because I look at them and feel nothing but a blank. As for my appetite or weight, I haven't really noticed any major changes.
